summary: BuzzFeed, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $120.0M private placement of 40,000,000 shares of Class A common stock at $3.00 per share to Allen Family Digital, LLC, an affiliate of Byron Allen's family office. The transaction closed on May 26, 2026. The filing also includes an amendment to the Director Appointment Agreement, expanding the board to nine directors and confirming Gregory Coleman's continued service. This is a capital infusion and governance change, not a typical special situation. The non-public registration and immediate control implications make it an 'Other' category. Watch for potential dilution and board dynamics post-closing.
